    "Model forecasts undershoot prices during uptrends by averaging away from recent highs",
    "Model lacks sensitivity to sentiment turning points, delaying corrections in opposite direction",

    "Forecast volatility is compressed relative to true outcomes, especially during sentiment-driven swings",
    "When sentiment shifts from positive to negative (or vice versa), model reacts too slowly by ~10-15% relative amount",
    "Forecast plateaus while true prices continue trending when deviation exceeds ~0.50"
